seo.title: Google Business Profile Holiday Hours: Setup Guide
seo.meta_description: Set Google Business Profile holiday hours and special hours for Anaheim and Orange County businesses: steps, the 6-day rule, temporary closures and tips.

h1: Google Business Profile Holiday Hours: How to Set Special Hours Correctly
answer: Google Business Profile holiday hours are set as special hours, which change your hours for specific dates without touching your regular schedule. Google says special hours suit closures of up to 6 days in a row; for 7 or more days, mark the business temporarily closed. Anaheim and Orange County businesses should confirm hours for every official holiday, even when they stay the same.
key_takeaways: Use special hours for holidays and events.
Special hours cover up to 6 days in a row.
Confirm hours for every official holiday.
Mark temporarily closed for 7 days or more.
Use More hours for delivery or senior hours.

sections.heading: Why holiday hours matter
sections.body_html: A customer who drives to a closed shop on a holiday rarely comes back, and one who sees open on Google when you are closed may leave a review about it. For Orange County businesses, the busy season around Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year, plus local events and conventions in Anaheim, makes accurate hours especially important.

sections.heading: What special hours are
sections.body_html: Google's help page says special hours let you change your hours of operation for a brief period, like a special event, so your regular hours do not change. You can schedule them for holidays, special events and other exceptional circumstances.

sections.heading: The 6-day rule
sections.body_html: Google says you can set special hours if your business temporarily adjusts its hours or remains closed for up to 6 days in a row. If you will be closed for 7 or more days, or for an unknown period, mark the business as temporarily closed instead.

sections.heading: Confirm hours even when nothing changes
sections.body_html: Google recommends confirming your hours for official holidays even if they are the same as your regular hours, because it makes clear to customers that your hours are accurate. Without confirmation, Google may show a note that hours could differ.

sections.heading: How to set special hours
sections.body_html: Go to your Business Profile, select Edit profile, then Hours. Next to Special hours, select Edit. Review a suggested date or add a custom date, then set your hours: uncheck Closed and enter times if you are open, or leave Closed checked if you are not. You can add more than one set of hours for a day. Save, and the special hours appear in your business information.

sections.heading: Open with main hours
sections.body_html: Google notes that for special hours to show, your business hours must be set to Open with main hours. If your profile has no regular hours, add them first.

sections.heading: Hours that run past midnight
sections.body_html: A set of special hours cannot exceed 24 hours. If you are open from the evening into the next day, Google says to split the hours into two sets: one that runs to the end of the first day and one that starts at midnight on the second. Regular hours for the second day are then ignored in favor of the special hours.

sections.heading: More hours for specific services
sections.body_html: If parts of your business keep different times, such as senior hours, delivery or takeout, Google suggests setting More hours instead of special hours. Restaurants and stores often need both.

sections.heading: Multi-location businesses
sections.body_html: Businesses with many locations can set special hours in a bulk upload spreadsheet using the Special hours column, with dates and times in Google's format and an x for all-day closures. Google warns that empty columns in a bulk upload can erase existing information, so include only what you mean to change.

sections.heading: Match your website and other listings
sections.body_html: Update holiday hours on your website, Apple Maps, Yelp and other listings at the same time. AI assistants and search engines compare sources, and conflicting hours make all of them less reliable.

sections.heading: Holiday hours checklist
sections.body_html:
• Regular hours set and the profile is Open with main hours.
  • Special hours added for each holiday that changes.
  • Unchanged holidays confirmed.
  • Closures of 7 days or more marked temporarily closed.
  • More hours set for delivery, takeout or senior hours.
  • Website, Apple Maps, Yelp and other listings updated to match.
  • A post announcing holiday hours.

sections.heading: Holidays to plan for
sections.body_html: Work through the calendar once a year and set special hours early. Common dates include New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and New Year's Eve. Add local factors too: in Anaheim, conventions and events can change when customers come, and some businesses extend hours rather than close. Setting all dates in one sitting means none are forgotten.

sections.heading: An example
sections.body_html: Imagine a restaurant near the Anaheim Convention Center. It closes on Thanksgiving Day, opens late on the Friday after, closes early on Christmas Eve and closes for a five-day refurbishment in January. Thanksgiving, the Friday and Christmas Eve are special hours. The five-day refurbishment also uses special hours, because it is under 7 days. If the refurbishment had run for two weeks, Google's guidance would point to marking the restaurant temporarily closed instead. The restaurant also posts an update with the holiday schedule.

sections.heading: How this fits your local plan
sections.body_html: Treat this as part of a routine rather than a one-off fix. Local visibility in Anaheim and the rest of Orange County comes from many small, accurate signals adding up: a verified profile, consistent listings, useful service pages, real photos and a flow of honest reviews. Google is open that relevance, distance and popularity drive local results. You cannot change distance, but you can make sure Google and AI assistants understand exactly what you do and see evidence that customers value it. Put a monthly reminder in the calendar to check the profile, read new reviews and update anything that has changed.

sections.heading: What to do this week
sections.body_html:
1. List every holiday for the next 12 months.
  2. Set special hours for each change.
  3. Confirm unchanged holidays.
  4. Update other listings to match.

sections.heading: When to get help
sections.body_html: Most of this can be done in-house with an hour or two and careful reading of Google's own help pages. It is worth bringing in help when the stakes are high or the problem keeps coming back: a profile that has been suspended more than once, many locations to manage, a site that keeps failing the same checks, or no time to keep up the routine. A good local SEO partner should explain what they will change and why, point to Google's guidelines rather than promise rankings, and leave you with access to every account. Chimera works this way with businesses across Anaheim and Orange County.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body_html: Set special hours for each holiday, confirm unchanged holidays, use temporarily closed for 7 days or more and update every other listing to match. Chimera, based in Anaheim, keeps holiday hours current for Orange County clients.

faqs.q: How do I add holiday hours on Google?
faqs.a: Edit profile, Hours, then Special hours; choose the date and set your hours or mark it closed.

faqs.q: How long can special hours last?
faqs.a: Google says special hours suit changes or closures of up to 6 days in a row.

faqs.q: What if I'm closed for two weeks?
faqs.a: Mark the business as temporarily closed; Google recommends this for 7 days or more.

faqs.q: Should I set holiday hours if they don't change?
faqs.a: Yes. Google recommends confirming hours for official holidays even if they are the same.

faqs.q: Why aren't my special hours showing?
faqs.a: Your business hours must be set to Open with main hours.
Separate hours for services such as delivery, takeout or senior hours.
